- The great and powerful nations of the world clashed in a series of titanic struggles, as the drums of war beat out a rhythm of destruction and despair.

- The world was plunged into a darkness of unprecedented proportions, as the very fabric of society was torn apart by the ravages of war and the Great Depression.

- And yet, even in the midst of this chaos and devastation, there were those who dared to dream of a better world, a world of peace and prosperity for all.

- The mighty rivers of progress flowed ever onward, bearing with them the hopes and aspirations of a generation.
